title: Validate Real Semantic Instances
description: Draft command semantic instance for validating committed real semantic instances, ADR records, and evidence records together.
purpose: Validate the committed semantic corpus and evidence records as real repository artefacts rather than fixtures, including cross-reference resolution and authority-boundary checks.
outputs: JSON validator result on standard output
failureSemantics: Non-zero exit indicates unresolved references, invalid real records, duplicate semantic identities, authority mismatch, proof/evidence failure, or unreadable input. This command validates existing artefacts and does not create proof evidence.
aiGuidance: Use this command before claiming repository-level instance readiness. Passing output is generated validation evidence, not semantic authority.
